page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 104 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per vCPU, which positions it as a high-density processing resource.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local storage is not attached, requiring storage configurations to rely on cloud block devices. In terms of cost efficiency, the low memory-to-vCPU ratio provides dense parallel processing capacity for compute-bound tasks without requiring expenditure on unneeded memory capacity.

This hardware profile is suited for compute-bound workloads, high-performance web application clusters, batch processing pipelines, distributed software compilation tasks, and engineering simulations that prioritize core parallelism over memory allocation per core.
